name: commons-take-paid-v1
description: ⭐ DEAN'S VARIANT (09/09/2026), PUT TO THE ENGINE SESSION IN THESE WORDS: "Play a card to take a bonus action. Then play a card to take all the cards from a pile. The take-a-pile action just gives you all the cards on a pile into your hand. The card you pay goes to the discard pile." rules.turn.commonsTake: 'paid'. THE SHIPPED RULE IS 'harvest' (C5): a central pile is reached only through the Harvest action, whole pile into the harvester's BARN, and this overlay is paired against it - it sets no other knob, so every other rule in the game is exactly the shipped commons and the whole delta is this one flag. IT IS ALSO PAIRED AGAINST overlays/commons-take-to-hand-v1.overlay.json ('bonus'), the free take: 'paid' is 'bonus' EXACTLY - Harvest never reaches the centre (harvestOptions returns own full buildings only, so the wheat board is offered only when the seat already has one, and commonsHarvestMin / commonsHarvestTake have no subject), a take always lands the whole pile in the taker's HAND, no board mix of its own - WITH ONE CHANGE: the take now COSTS one card from the taker's own hand, discarded to ITS OWN suit's discard pile BEFORE the pile moves, never onto the pile it is paying to take and never boxed. The commonsTake move carries an optional fee, required under this knob; enumerateCommonsTake offers one move per (non-empty board, card in hand) pair, the same shape enumerateCommons walks for the paid commons play, so the fee can never be one of the taken cards - it comes out of the hand, the taken cards come out of the pile, and the two pools never overlap. ⭐ WHY IT MATTERS: it is THE FIRST PER-USE SINK ANYWHERE IN THE COMMONS LINE. 'bonus' keeps the take free and 'spend' only ever discards a card that was already in the centre and had nowhere left to go (D-S2); 'paid' is the first value to burn a card that never touches a central pile at all, on every single take. A Helping Hand still grants at most two bonus uses of either kind (play twice, take twice, or one of each, never three) and bonusTiming 'start' (the shipped order) still offers the slot only before the main action - neither of those moved. ⭐ WHAT TO READ. a17-bonus-mix prints the SAME three columns 'bonus' introduced - PLAY (paid) / TAKE (now also paid) / SLOT UNSPENT - read on the slot's TOTAL use, Dean's band unchanged; the 'free option's share of used slots' line 'bonus' and 'spend' both print is replaced here, because there is no free option left in the slot to watch for crowding out - both halves now cost a card, so PLAY/TAKE is a choice between two prices rather than a price and a freebie. a18-commons-traffic's harvest-side readings - central harvests, the harvest histogram, the wheat-board split - all read 0 or 'no subject' BY CONSTRUCTION under this knob, for the same reason 'bonus' states, and are replaced with takes per player per game, the take-size distribution, a TAKE FEES DISCARDED line (the sink, and the number to watch first), the conservation line re-derived as cards played onto boards = taken to hand + stranded (the fee never joins this identity, because it never touches a central pile), and a SECOND identity alongside it: cards paid as take fees = cards discarded, which balances by construction because fx.discardFromHand discards the exact card doCommonsTake just charged. The farm-bypass reading reads 0% centre-to-barn by construction, exactly as under 'bonus', because Harvest still never reaches the centre; read the hand-arrival count beside the fee count, since a seat nets takenCards minus feesPaid cards from a run of takes, never the raw pile size. UNRUN BEFORE THIS PASS.
